title: Summer opportunities, new members and a growing map

sections.heading: Community news
items: The QIST platform is live: researcher map, searchable directory, channels and academic matching.
New members joined from the US, UK, UAE, Japan and South Korea — welcome! Add yourself via registration.
The autumn QIST online seminar series is now accepting speakers — see the Conferences channel.

sections.heading: Opportunities picked for you
items: Bolashak 2026 call for PhD and research internships is open (deadline 1 October).
MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships close 10 September — EU host labs, all disciplines.
Faculty openings in CS at Nazarbayev University; postdoc positions at MBZUAI.

sections.heading: From the channels
items: Collaboration: survey on Kazakh & Turkic low-resource NLP is looking for co-authors.
Collaboration: deep-learning radiology group is seeking a clinical partner in Kazakhstan.
General: community thread on postdoc application advice keeps growing.

title: Grants season and how to find your co-author

sections.heading: Community news
items: Academic matching launched in beta: describe your interests and get ranked collaborator suggestions.
The researcher map now clusters members by city — see where Kazakhstani science lives worldwide.

sections.heading: Opportunities
items: MSHE RK Zhas Galym grants for scientists under 40 — watch the NCSTE portal for call dates.
NeurIPS travel funding round-up posted in the Conferences channel.

sections.heading: Why QIST
items: Thousands of researchers from Kazakhstan work across the globe, often without knowing about each other.
QIST connects them: a directory, a map, shared opportunities and a route to collaborations.
This platform is community-built and open source — contributions welcome on GitHub.

sections.heading: Get started
items: Create an account to appear in the directory.
Post jobs, grants and conference calls to the channels.
